champion_ineligibility_is_a_consequence_.derivation: config/models/cell_foundation.toml records exposure_status = encoder_seen for scimilarity_v1_1, the only encoder_seen row in the entire model census. encoder_seen is one of the seven states enumerated in config/resources.toml [semantics].exposure_statuses and is outside the two-state champion-permitting subset. config/artifacts/models/scimilarity/exposure_audit.json therefore records sealed_champion_eligibility = ineligible_aggregate_development_encoder_seen and sealed_champion_eligible = false, and the frozen extraction receipt independently carries sealed_champion_eligible = false. This is the rule applied, not a judgement about the model.
champion_ineligibility_is_a_consequence_.underlying_overlap: The complete declared SCimilarity table identifies GSE185477 as an annotated training source and GSE136103 as reference_only, so the aggregate seven-study development exposure is encoder_seen. The sealed target itself is separately classified target_label_unexposed because GSE289173 became public after the finalized v1.1 Zenodo record.

closes: OVERALL_PLAN.md completion criterion 1: every required model family must carry an exact-checkpoint, license, exposure, runtime and native-task disposition. This record supplies the missing native-task axis only.
disposition_scope: Native-task disposition only. This record adds no capability, opens no checkpoint, deserializes nothing, and bypasses no license gate. The base registry under config/models/ is unchanged.

exposure_rule.frozen_vocabulary: config/resources.toml [semantics].exposure_statuses enumerates the seven permitted checkpoint exposure states: clean_declared, target_label_unexposed, encoder_seen, continual_seen, reference_only, downstream_demo, unknown.
exposure_rule.scope_caveat: Both frozen enumerations of the two-state subset are prespecified for the GSE281364 sequence lane. config/tasks/cell_state_mapping.toml declares no allowed_checkpoint_exposure list of its own. For the cell_state_mapping lane the binding authority is therefore each family's own exposure audit under config/artifacts/models/<family>/exposure_audit.json, which records sealed_champion_eligibility directly.

root_cause.consequence: No per-model cell_state_mapping capability row exists to carry a native-task disposition, so the disposition is recorded here instead. Adding rows to the capability registry is a separate, non-additive change and is deliberately not attempted.
root_cause.finding: config/evaluation/cell_state_mapping_capabilities.toml carries no [[models]] roster. It is 12 lines of task-level scope with four family names, a baseline list and an ATAC-only exclusion, and it names no per-model row. config/evaluation/variant_to_regulation_capabilities.toml carries 40 per-model rows over 411 lines. That structural asymmetry, not a missing judgement, is why the cell_state_mapping native-task column is empty for every family in this record.
